pr.title: Upgrade data-api to .NET 8 and update NuGet dependencies

story.user_story: As a developer, I want to upgrade the existing .NET Web API (data-api) to .NET 8, analyze the current implementation, and update all dependent packages, so that the application benefits from improved performance, security, and modern .NET capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The existing data-api project is upgraded to .NET 8.
All project files (.csproj) reflect TargetFramework as net8.0.
Existing code is analyzed for compatibility issues and refactored if required.
Deprecated APIs (if any) are replaced with supported alternatives.
All NuGet packages are upgraded to their latest stable versions compatible with .NET 8.
Entity Framework Core is upgraded to EF Core 8 (if used).
PostgreSQL provider (Npgsql) is upgraded to a compatible version.
Application builds successfully without warnings or errors.
All existing endpoints (e.g., GET /api/employees) work as expected after upgrade.
Regression testing is completed to ensure no functional breakage.

notes: Upgraded EF Core to 8.x and Npgsql provider to 8.x.
Removed WeatherForecast template controller/model per proj.md instructions.
